scope: General public EE estimator checked against independent enumeration; corrected symmetric neighborhood variances, no experimental error inputs. These counts are independently derived, not numbers printed in Wagner 2023.
preprocessing: Keep all sequences and W_ParE3 fitness without rescaling; restrict neighbors to one-nucleotide-accessible amino-acid replacements. Use population variation among non-focal neighbor fitnesses, symmetric endpoint variance sum, df=min(k_source,k_target)-1 and separate BH families at FDR .01. Full precision effects; all represented ordered pairs.

sources.locator: Results: EE mutations are rare in the protein adaptive landscape; Supplementary Fig. S1.
delfit, del_neigh_fit_del_fit_0 and del_neigh_fit_0_0 columns; companion adaptive_walks notebook classification cell.

comparison.justification: Integer classification counts from the separately implemented SciPy summary-statistic oracle. No published-result equivalence is claimed.
